## Mouse
### Download dataset
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Mouse-------
#Download datasets

#GSE120661 ----

#Metadata 
filename = "GSE120661"
GSE120661 <- getGEO("GSE120661", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 
eset <- GSE120661[[1]]

GSE120661_metadata = eset %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    subject_id = "title",
    sex = "gender:ch1", 
    treatment = "treatment:ch1", 
    tissue = "tissue:ch1",
    timepoint = "timepoint:ch1",
    animal_replicate = "animal replicate:ch1",
    strain = "strain/background:ch1") %>% 
  mutate(treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "saline"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, "0"),
         condition = paste(treatment, timepoint, tissue, sep = "_"))

#Save
write_csv(GSE120661_metadata, file = here("tables", "influenza_hepatitisb_GSE120661_metadata.csv"))

#Counts matrix from Expression set
eset <- exprs(eset)

eset %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_hepatitisb_GSE120661_exprs.rds"))

```

Import
```{r}
#Import
GSE120661_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_metadata.rds"))
GSE120661_exprs = read_rds(here("tables", "influenza_hepatitisb_GSE120661_exprs.rds"))

#Check length
GSE120661_exprs %>% rownames() %>% length()

mouse_fluad_metadata = GSE120661_metadata %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Fluad",
         tissue == "PBMC") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint) %>% as.numeric(),
         timepoint = (timepoint / 24) %>% round(1),
         participant_id = paste0("TriFLU-MF59_BL", animal_replicate)) %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7))

#Save
mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Select only PBMC samples counts

  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(c(mouse_fluad_metadata$geo_sample)) %>% 
  as.matrix()

GSE120661_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs.rds"))
```

### Annotate genes
```{r}
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% rownames()

#Get other annotations
listAttributes(ensembl_mart)

#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k", #Agilent microarray data (design ID 028005, retrieved from GEO)
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k",
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart)

#Get lookup table from FIT
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = mouse_ortholog)

#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
mouse_fluad_log2summary = GSE120661_exprs %>% #20,845 probes
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k), 
            by = "probe") %>%  #24.009 rows
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = entrezgene_id) %>% 
  
  #Filter hgnc symbol
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, by = c("mouse_entrez", "mgi_symbol")) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1)  %>% #14.396
  ungroup()

#Filter out genes with multiple mgi_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = mouse_fluad_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple mgi_symbols
  get_dupes(hgnc_symbol)

mouse_fluad_log2summary = mouse_fluad_log2summary %>% 
  filter(!hgnc_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$hgnc_symbol %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

#Filtered probes
mouse_fluad_log2_filtered_probes = GSE120661_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(human_symbol = hgnc_symbol,
         human_entrez,
         mouse_entrez,
         c(mouse_fluad_metadata$geo_sample))
#14395
mouse_fluad_log2_filtered_probes %>% dim()

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = mouse_fluad_log2_filtered_probes 

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% get_dupes(human_symbol)

#Save 
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
```

Create expression set
```{r}
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_metadata.rds")) 


#Annotate
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  # rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, human_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")

#Save
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))


#Pivot wider
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_wide = mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  select(-c(value:day0)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id",
              values_from = "log2fc")

beep()

```


### Differential gene expression
```{r}
#Create ExpressionSet --------------
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_metadata.rds")) 


GSE120661_exprs_matrix_fluad = mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%

  select(human_symbol, c(mouse_fluad_metadata$geo_sample)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()

#Normalize quantiles
GSE120661_exprs_matrix_fluad_normalized <- normalizeBetweenArrays(GSE120661_exprs_matrix_fluad, 
                                                                   method = "quantile")

#Diagnostics
dim(GSE120661_exprs_matrix_fluad_normalized) #14357   20

dim(AnnotatedDataFrame(mouse_fluad_metadata %>% column_to_rownames("geo_sample"))) #35
```

```{r}
#Create new Expression set with the filtered data
eset_filtered <- ExpressionSet(

#Save
eset_filtered %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_eset.rds"))
```

#### Limma

```{r}
#Create design matrix -------
eset_mouse_fluad = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_eset.rds"))

design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + 0, eset_mouse_fluad) # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate correlation between doses on the same individual
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_mouse_fluad, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_mouse_fluad$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.024

# Use the correlation into the linear model
#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_mouse_fluad, design, 
             block = eset_mouse_fluad$participant_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus)

#Contrasts
#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(timepoint1  - timepoint0 ,
                             timepoint3  - timepoint0 ,
                             timepoint7  - timepoint0 ,
                             levels=design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)

# eBayes
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

#Get DEGs ------
## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
    
})

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
all_degs_mouse = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "Time1"	~ "Fluad_1_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time3"	~ "Fluad_3_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time7"	~ "Fluad_7_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA),
         timepoint = str_remove(comparisonA, "Time"),
         organism = "Mouse") %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  select(condition, symbol, mean = log_fc, lower = ci_l, upper = ci_r, ave_expr,
         everything())

all_degs_mouse %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())
	
#Save
all_degs_mouse %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
```


#### Simple t-Test
```{r}
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")) %>% 
  distinct()
```


```{r}
#Compute summary statistics
fluad_log2fc_summary = mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  # rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") 

# Paired t-test
mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest <- mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
mouse_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest <- mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired")

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(mouse_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest) 

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```


## Human

### Download dataset
Data was quantile normalized signal intensity using limma 3.38.3, read.maimages source = agilent.median, backgroundCorrect method= normexp, normalizeBetweenArrays method= quantile. Ref: GEO.

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
### Download dataset --------
# Data was quantile normalized signal intensity using limma 3.38.3, read.maimages source = agilent.median, backgroundCorrect method= normexp, normalizeBetweenArrays method= quantile. Ref: GEO

###### GSE124689 ----
#Download dataset
GSE124689 <- getGEO("GSE124689", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 
#Get ExpressionSet
eset <- GSE124689[[1]]
#Expression
GSE124689_exprs <- eset %>% exprs()
#Metadata
GSE124689_metadata = eset %>% pData()
#Save
GSE124689_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_human_GSE124689_exprs.rds"))
```

Import data
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Import data
GSE124689_exprs = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_human_GSE124689_exprs.rds"))

#Get metadata annotated by Amnah
# cleandata_nonorm_flu <- readRDS(here("HumanFluData", "cleandata_nonorm_flu.rds")) 
flu_expFC <- readRDS(here("HumanFluData", "expFC.rds"))
# flu_expression_fc = flu_expFC[["exp_fc"]] %>% as.data.frame()
flu_metadata = flu_expFC$cur_phenoData
flu_metadata %>% filter(exposure_material_reported == "FLUADD")

#Filter samples by vaccine
human_samples_pbmc_fluad = flu_metadata %>% 
  filter(exposure_material_reported == "FLUADD")
```

### Annotate features
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
# Annotate genes
probes_annotation <- read.delim(here("tables", "GPL21272-58809.txt"), skip = 19, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "") %>% 
  select(gene_id = ID, entrez_id = ENTREZ_GENE_ID, ensembl_id = ENSEMBL_ID, gene_symbol = GENE_SYMBOL) %>% 
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id))

GSE124689_counts <- GSE124689_exprs %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>% 
  inner_join(probes_annotation, by = "gene_id") %>% 
  select(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol, c(human_samples_pbmc_fluad$biosample_accession)) %>% 
  mutate(entrez_id = as.character(entrez_id)) 

#Get probes and entrez IDs with the highest median by ensembl_id
GSE124689_counts_genes_selected = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol),
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(entrez_id, gene_id) %>% 
  drop_na(entrez_id) %>% 
  summarise(median = median(expression),
            median = round(median, 10)) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Merge
GSE124689_counts_raw = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  inner_join(GSE124689_counts_genes_selected %>% 
               select(gene_id, entrez_id),
             by = join_by("gene_id", "entrez_id"))

#Delete duplicates by sampling
dupes_entrez = GSE124689_counts_genes_selected %>% 
  get_dupes(entrez_id) %>% 
  group_by(entrez_id) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1)

#Merge
human_fluadd_not_normalized = GSE124689_counts_raw %>%
  select(-gene_symbol) %>% 
  filter(!gene_id %in% c(dupes_entrez$gene_id)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(c(entrez_id, human_samples_pbmc_fluad$uid)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("entrez_id") 

#Save
human_fluadd_not_normalized %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_GSE124689_exprs.rds"))

#Get symbols only
GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol),
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(gene_symbol, gene_id) %>% 
  filter(gene_symbol != "") %>% 
  drop_na(gene_symbol) %>% 
  summarise(median = median(expression),
            median = round(median, 10)) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  inner_join(GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol %>% 
               select(gene_id, gene_symbol),
             by = join_by("gene_id", "gene_symbol"))

dupes_symbols = GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol %>% 
  get_dupes(gene_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1)

human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol = GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol %>%
  filter(!gene_symbol %in% c(dupes_symbols$gene_symbol)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(c(gene_symbol, human_samples_pbmc_fluad$uid)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol")

human_fluadd_symbol_entrez = GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol %>%
  filter(!gene_symbol %in% c(dupes_symbols$gene_symbol)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(symbol = gene_symbol, entrez_id)

#Save
human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_GSE124689_exprs_not_normalized.rds"))


human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol %>% 
  rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(columns_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2fc")

human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol
```


```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Counts matrix from Expression set
flu_metadata_clean = flu_metadata %>% 
  arrange(uid) %>% 
  separate(participant_id, into = c("del", "participant_id")) %>% 
  select(-del) %>% 
  select(sample_id = uid, participant_id, timepoint = study_time_collected, age = age_imputed, sex = gender, race, vaccine = exposure_material_reported, sample_type = cell_type, array = featureSetName2, type = vaccine_type, adjuvant) %>% 
  mutate(age = as.numeric(age),
         sex = as.factor(sex), 
         race = as.factor(race),
         condition = paste(vaccine, "Day", timepoint)) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% c(GSE124689_counts %>% colnames())) %>% 
  arrange(sample_id) %>%
```

#### Limma
```{r}
# DGE -------

#Create ExpressionSet

  assayData = human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human,

#Save
```

```{r}
##### Run analysis in the cluster -------
eset_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "fluad_eset_human.rds"))
#Create design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + sex + age + race + 0, eset_human) 
#Avoid blank spaces
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

#Get intra-individual correlation
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_human, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_human$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.11

# Fit Limma model
fluad_human_limma_fit <- lmFit(eset_human, 
                             design, 
                             block = eset_human$participant_id, 
                             correlation = corfit$consensus)

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionFLUADD.Day.1 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                             conditionFLUADD.Day.3 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                             conditionFLUADD.Day.7 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                             levels=design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fluad_human_limma_fit, cont.matrix)

# eBayes
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)


fit2 %>% saveRDS(here("tables","fluad_human_limma_fit.rds"))


# Import results from cluster -------
fit2 = readRDS(here("tables","fluad_human_limma_fit.rds"))

#Get DEGs ------
## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
fluad_human_degs = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace_all(comparison, "\\.", " "),
        comparison = str_replace_all(comparison, "condition", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  select(condition = comparisonA, everything()) %>% 
  select(-comparisonRef) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  select(condition, symbol, mean = log_fc, lower = ci_l, upper = ci_r, ave_expr,
         everything()) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData %>% 
               select(condition, timepoint, vaccine, sample_type) %>% 
               distinct(), by = "condition") %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human") 

#Save
fluad_human_degs %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

#Print results

fluad_human_degs %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())
```


#### Simple t-Test
```{r}
eset_human_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_eset.rds"))
human_mouse_fluad_matrix = eset_human_mouse %>% exprs()
human_mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_metadata.rds.png"))


human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human = human_mouse_fluad_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(c(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
           filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
             filter(!participant_id %in% c("CRC305DGENT1483036",
                                             "CRC305DGENT0351013",
                                             "CRC305DGENT1471032")) %>% 
             pull(sample_id))) %>% 
  as.matrix()

human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData = human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
                                   column_to_rownames("sample_id") %>% 
                                   filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
                                   filter(!participant_id %in% c("CRC305DGENT1483036",
                                             "CRC305DGENT0351013",
                                             "CRC305DGENT1471032")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.factor(timepoint),
         sex = as.factor(sex),
         age = scale(as.numeric(age)),
         race = as.factor(race))

#Annotate
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData %>% 
               rownames_to_column("geo_sample") %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, human_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData %>% 
               rownames_to_column("geo_sample") %>% 
               select(participant_id, timepoint, geo_sample),
             by = join_by("participant_id", "timepoint"))

#Save
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_log2fc_sample_long.rds"))


#Pivot wider
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_wide = human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  select(-c(value:day0)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id",
              values_from = "log2fc")

beep()
```


```{r}
#Import
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_log2fc_sample_long.rds"))


#Compute summary statistics
human_fluad_log2fc_summary = human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

human_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData %>% 
               rownames_to_column("geo_sample") %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_")

# Paired t-test
human_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest <- human_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

# Unpaired t-test ----------
human_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest <- human_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(
      t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(
      t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(
      t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      timepoint == "day1" ~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
      timepoint == "day3" ~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
      timepoint == "day7" ~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
      TRUE ~ timepoint),
    timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
    test = "t-Test",
    paired = "Unpaired")




human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = human_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(human_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest) 

human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

### Compare DGE methods
```{r}
#Import ------
#t-Test
human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")
mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse")

#Limma
human_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired") 

mouse_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired") 

#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma =
  bind_rows(
    human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    human_degs,
    mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    mouse_degs
    )

#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_summary = degs_ttest_limma %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, test, paired) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0("Day", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

degs_ttest_limma_summary
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# Plot number of DEGs per test and significance level
degs_ttest_limma_summary_plot_gg <- degs_ttest_limma_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = timepoint,
    y = n_degs,
    fill = test,
    alpha = paired
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_dodge2()) +
  
  # Manual colors per test
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "t-Test" = "gray25",
    "Limma" = "#4DBBD5FF"
  )) +
  
  # Alpha: paired = 1, unpaired = 0.5
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Paired" = 1, "Unpaired" = 0.2)) +
  
  # Continuous x-axis for numeric timepoints
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = sort(unique(degs_ttest_limma_summary$timepoint)),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(
    title = "Total DEGs by test and timepoint",
    subtitle = "Comparison across tests (FDR ≤ 0.05)",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = "Test",
    alpha = "Pairing"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~organism, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray75", linetype = 3),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray75")
  )
```

```{r}
                values_to = "value_raw"))

#Annotate ------
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn = human_mouse_fluad_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(-symbol,
               names_to = "sample_id",
               values_to = "value_qn") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_not_normalized, 
               by = join_by("symbol", "sample_id")) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata,
             by = "sample_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(value_qn, value_raw),
               names_to = "measure",
               values_to = "value")

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn.rds"))

#Calculate the avg expression
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>% 
  group_by(symbol, organism, timepoint, measure) %>% 
  summarise(avg = mean(value),
            n_subjects = n(),
            sd = sd(value),
            se = sd/sqrt(n_subjects)) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn_avg.rds"))


# Log2FoldChange ------
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  filter(measure %in% c("value_qn", "value_raw"),
         # timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7)
         ) %>%
  select(participant_id, symbol, timepoint, value, measure, organism) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, symbol, measure) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn_log2fc.rds"))

#Average L2FC
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  group_by(symbol, organism, timepoint, measure) %>% 
  summarise(avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = T),
            n_subjects = n(),
            #Dispersion
            sd = sd(value, na.rm = T),
            se = sd/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size = avg_log2fc/sd,
            #Get pval from paired t-test
    pval = tryCatch(t.test(value, day0, paired = TRUE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se,
         ci_high = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se,
         pval_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr"))
  
#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn_log2fc_avg.rds"))

beep()
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human, matched timepoints ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- timepoints_human

#Matched timepoints
timepoint_combinations <- tibble(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                 timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse)

# Loop for matched timepoints
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_genes <- intersect(human_df$human_symbol, mouse_df$human_symbol)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "human_symbol")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "human_symbol")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse)
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 2) Human vs Human ---
cor_human_human <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Human vs. Human",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


#Unite
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_human_mouse_timepoint %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_mouse) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    cor_human_human,
    cor_mouse_mouse)
```

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=18}
  facet_grid(~measure~fct_rev(organism), scales = "free_x", space = "free", axes = "all_x", axis.labels = "all_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), 
                     # limits = c(-1, 1)
                     )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF")) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white", size = 10, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
        ) +
  labs(fill = "Organism",
       x = "Participant",
       y = "Log2-Fold Change")

distribution_check_subject_raw_qn_log2fc_plot
```

##### Plot volcano plot
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=16}
#Volcano plot -------
volcano_data <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
  mutate(logp = -log10(pval_adj),
         sig = case_when(avg_log2fc > 0 & logp > 2 ~ "Up",
                         avg_log2fc < 0 & logp > 2 ~ "Down",
                         TRUE ~ "NS"),
         measure = case_when(measure == "value_qn" ~ "QN",
                             measure == "value_raw" ~ "Raw",
                             T~measure))
volcano_plot_raw_qn = volcano_data %>% 
ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg_log2fc, y = logp, fill = sig) +
  facet_nested(~paste("Day", timepoint)+organism + measure, scales = "free_y",  space = "free_y", nest_line = element_line(linetype = 1, color = "black")) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = sig,
                 color = sig),
             pch = 21, 
             size = 1, 
             alpha = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = 1, size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, color = "black", linetype = 2, size = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(2, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60),
                     limits = c(0, 70),
                     expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  guides(color = F) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "#165289", 
      "Down" = "#45efc6",
      "NS" = "gray80")) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "#165289", 
      "Down" = "#45efc6",
      "NS" = "gray80")) +
  labs(x = "Log2-Fold Change",
       y = "-log(FDR)",
       fill = "Direction") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0)) 

volcano_plot_raw_qn

#Save
volcano_plot_raw_qn %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_qc_volcano_plot_raw_qn.png"),
         width = 16,
         height = 3)
```

## FIT
Ref: Normand, R., Du, W., Briller, M. et al. Found In Translation: a machine learning model for mouse-to-human inference. Nat Methods 15, 1067–1073 (2018). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-018-0214-9
Github: https://github.com/shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man 

### Run prediction
Import package
```{r}
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
#Import files
pca_rotations = FIT.mouse2man::pca_rotations
best_models = FIT.mouse2man::best_models
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez
MM_Entrez_symbol_desc = FIT.mouse2man::MM_Entrez_symbol_desc
Psoriasis_classifier_neg = FIT.mouse2man::Psoriasis_classifier_neg
slopes_per_gene_V2.0 = FIT.mouse2man::slopes_per_gene_V2.0
StaphInfection_classifier_pos = FIT.mouse2man::StaphInfection_classifier_pos
AllData_V2.0 = FIT.mouse2man::AllData_V2.0 #Training data
```

Obs.: Make sure that datasets from FIT package were retrieved
Initial number of genes: 15503
Number of genes for which FIT predictions will be calculated: 14401


```{r}
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) 

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
### Loop for every time point -----
all_degs_fit2 = all_degs_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, EffectSize = logFC, condition) %>%
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
               select(symbol = human_symbol, MM.Entrez = mouse_entrez),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(row = MM.Entrez)

# Generate csv for every condition
all_conditions <- unique(all_degs_fit2$condition)
purrr::walk(all_conditions, function(cond) {
  
  delete_dupes <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond) %>%
    get_dupes(row) %>%
    pull(row)
  
  filtered_df <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond, !row %in% delete_dupes) %>%
    select(-condition) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("row") %>% 
    select(MM.Entrez, EffectSize)
  
  file_name <- paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv")
  file_path <- here("tables", file_name)
  
  write_csv(filtered_df, file_path)
})

# FIT loop
fit_results_combined <- map2_dfr(all_conditions, all_conditions, function(cond, cond_name) {
  
  file_path <- here("tables", paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv"))
  
  fit_output <- FIT.mouse2man::FIT(MouseFile = file_path, DataType = "rnaseq")

  fit_output_tbl <- as_tibble(fit_output) %>%
    mutate(condition = cond_name)
  
  return(fit_output_tbl)
})
beep()
#Print
fit_results_combined

#Save
fit_results_combined %>% saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_fit_prediction_alltimes.rds"))


#Visualize distribution
fit_results_combined %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = FIT_prediction,
      fill = condition,
      color = condition) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_vaxgo()
```

### Integrate Mouse, FIT, and Human data
```{r}
#Import datasets
fit_example_results_ready = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_fit_prediction_example_results_ready.rds"))
fluad_human_degs = read_rds(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
all_degs_mouse = read_rds(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
GSE120661_metadata = read_csv(here("tables", "influenza_hepatitisb_GSE120661_metadata.csv")) 
human_mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Clean tables
human_mouse_fluad_metadata_datasets = human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
  select(vaccine, sample_type, timepoint, condition, organism, type, array) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))


# Annotate genes by entrez_id ------
#Get gene annotation
genes_ann = fit_example_results_ready %>% 
  select(mouse_entrez, human_entrez,human_symbol) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(human_entrez = as.character(human_entrez))

#Human
fluad_human = fluad_human_degs %>% 
  select(condition,
         human_symbol = symbol, 
         log2fc = mean,
         ci_low = lower,
         ci_high = upper,
         p_value,
         adj_p_val,
         organism,
         t
         ) %>% 
  mutate(ci_size = ci_high - ci_low,
         organism = "Human") %>% 
  inner_join(genes_ann, by = join_by("human_symbol")) %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol)

#Mouse
fluad_mouse = all_degs_mouse %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol, 
         log2fc = logFC,
         ci_low = CI.L,
         ci_high = CI.R,
         p_value = P.Value,
         adj_p_val = adj.P.Val,
         t,
         ) %>% 
  mutate(ci_size = ci_high - ci_low,
         organism = "Mouse")

#FIT
fluad_fit = fit_example_results_ready %>% 
  filter(measure == "fit_prediction") %>% 
  select(condition, 
         mouse_entrez, 
         human_entrez,
         mouse_symbol,
         symbol = human_symbol, 
         log2fc = value,
         ci_low,
         ci_high,
         ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "FIT",
         ci_size = ci_high - ci_low) %>% 
  #Get only the human entrez id used
  filter(human_entrez %in% c(fluad_human$human_entrez)) %>% 
  select(!c(mouse_entrez, human_entrez, mouse_symbol)) %>% 
  #Calculate pvalues
   mutate(
  se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
  z = log2fc / se,
  p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z)),
  adj_p_val = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% 
  select(-se)

#Combine tables
fit_fluad_mouse_human = fluad_human %>% 
  bind_rows(fluad_mouse, 
            fluad_fit) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_datasets %>% 
               select(condition, vaccine, timepoint, type),
             by = "condition") %>% 
  arrange(symbol) %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(1, 3, 7)) %>% 
  select(!c(human_entrez, mouse_entrez))

#Save
fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_fit_dge_degs.rds"))

#Save long dataset
fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  mutate(condition =  paste(organism, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_fit_dge_degs_long.rds"))

#Print
fit_fluad_mouse_human

```


6373 human genes were analyzed

Filtered:
- 5563 genes with padj > 0.10
- 3673 genes with padj > 0.50
- 1001 genes with padj > 0.90

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
         t_mouse = t,
         mean_mouse = log2fc, 
         ci_low_mouse = ci_low,
         ci_high_mouse = ci_high,
         ci_width_mouse = ci_size,
         pval_adj_mouse = adj_p_val,
         pval_mouse = p_value
         ) %>% 
  #Filter out repeated values
  arrange(symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(mean_mouse_round =  mean_mouse %>% round(3),
           value = (ci_high_mouse + ci_low_mouse) / 2,
         value = value %>% round(3)) %>% 
  mutate(test = if_else(value == mean_mouse_round, "T", "no")) %>% 
  filter(test == "T") %>% 
  select(-c(test, value, mean_mouse_round))

#Human
meta_human = fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(symbol, 
         timepoint, 
         t_human = t,
         mean_human = log2fc, 
         ci_low_human = ci_low,
         ci_high_human = ci_high,
         ci_width_human = ci_size,
         pval_adj_human = adj_p_val,
         pval_human = p_value)

#Unite and calculate summary statistics
pairwise_human_fit_measures = meta_human %>% 
  inner_join(meta_fit, by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(meta_mouse, by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(human_2_mouse = mean_human - mean_mouse,
         human_2_fit = mean_human - mean_fit) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  
    mutate(
    # Estimate SE from CIs
    se_human = (ci_high_human - ci_low_human) / (2 * 1.96),
    se_fit = (ci_high_fit - ci_low_fit) / (2 * 1.96),
    se_mouse = (ci_high_mouse - ci_low_mouse) / (2 * 1.96),
    
    # Combine SE
    se_diff_h2fit = sqrt(se_human^2 + se_fit^2),
    se_diff_h2m = sqrt(se_human^2 + se_mouse^2),
    
    # Z score
    z_score_h2fit = human_2_fit / se_diff_h2fit,
    z_score_h2m = human_2_mouse / se_diff_h2m,
    
    # p-value
    p_value_h2fit = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score_h2fit))),
    p_value_h2m = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score_h2m))),
    
    # FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg)
    p_value_h2fit_adj = p.adjust(p_value_h2fit, method = "BH"),
    p_value_h2m_adj = p.adjust(p_value_h2m, method = "BH"),
    
    # Cohen's d
    effect_size_h2fit = human_2_fit / se_diff_h2fit,
    effect_size_h2m = human_2_mouse / se_diff_h2m)  %>% 
  
  
  #Reorder cols
  select(
    timepoint, symbol,
    #Human
    mean_human, t_human,
    ci_low_human, ci_high_human, ci_width_human,
    se_human, pval_human, pval_adj_human,
    #FIT
    mean_fit, z_fit,
    ci_low_fit, ci_high_fit, ci_width_fit,
    se_fit, pval_fit, pval_adj_fit,
    #Mouse
    mean_mouse, t_mouse,
    ci_low_mouse, ci_high_mouse, ci_width_mouse,
    se_mouse, pval_mouse, pval_adj_mouse,
    #Comparison
    human_2_mouse,
    human_2_fit,
    se_diff_h2fit, se_diff_h2m,
    z_score_h2fit, z_score_h2m,
    p_value_h2fit, p_value_h2fit_adj,
    p_value_h2m, p_value_h2m_adj,
    effect_size_h2fit, effect_size_h2m
  )

#Save wide dataset
pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_fit_dge_pairwise2human.rds"))

#Print
pairwise_human_fit_measures
```

#### Differential expression 
##### Limma
Paired samples design
```{r}

#Import
mouse_engerixb_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_exprs.rds"))
mouse_engerixb_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_metadata.rds"))
eset_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_eset.rds"))

#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
                       eset_mouse) 
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject (paired-samples)
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_mouse, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_mouse$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #-0.02688727

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_mouse, 
             design, 
             block = eset_mouse$participant_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus) #Use inter-subject correlation as input into the linear model fit

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionEngerix.B_24_PBMC	 - conditionEngerix.B_0_PBMC,
                             conditionEngerix.B_72_PBMC	 - conditionEngerix.B_0_PBMC,
                             conditionEngerix.B_168_PBMC	 - conditionEngerix.B_0_PBMC,
                             levels=design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs_mouse_engerixb = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionEngerix.B_24_PBMC"	~ "Engerix_24_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionEngerix.B_72_PBMC"	~ "Engerix_72_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionEngerix.B_168_PBMC"	~ "Engerix_168_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Mouse") %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)
	
# #Save
all_degs_mouse_engerixb %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

all_degs_mouse_engerixb %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())

```

##### Simple t-Test
```{r}
#Import
mouse_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
#Import
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_exprs.rds")) %>% 
  distinct()

mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_metadata.rds"))

```


```{r}
#Compute summary statistics
mouse_log2fc_summary = mouse_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") 

# Paired t-test
mouse_log2fc_paired_ttest <- mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
mouse_log2fc_unpaired_ttest <- mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired")

mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = mouse_log2fc_paired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(mouse_log2fc_unpaired_ttest) 

mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

#### Correlation plots, pairwise

Plot correlations between mouse samples across all timepoints using
pairwise scatterplots and density plots from the GGally package.

To do this, define custom plotting functions for densities on the
diagonal and points on the lower panels, then apply ggpairs to the
filtered log2 fold change expression matrix. Reorder the timepoints as
factors, color and fill by timepoint, and apply a custom theme along
with manual color scales.

The result is a matrix of correlation plots titled “All days,
HepB/EngerixB, GSE120661, C57BL/6J”.

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Plot correlation between animals ------
#Change params in geoms
#Density
my_dens <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data = data, mapping=mapping) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2, color = "black")
}
#Points
my_point <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, ...)  
}

#All timepoints
mouse_correlation_ggpairs_alldays = ggpairs(mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_wide %>% 
                                              mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
                                                     timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, as.numeric(timepoint))),
                                    columns = 3:7,
                                    mapping = ggplot2::aes(color = timepoint,
                                                           fill = timepoint),
                                    title = "All days, HepB/EngerixB, GSE120661, C57BL/6J", 
                                    diag = list(continuous = my_dens),
                                    lower = list(continuous = my_point)
                                    ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "3" = "#219ebc",
                                "7" = "#669bbc",
                                "12" = "#4361ee")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "3" = "#219ebc",
                                "7" = "#669bbc",
                                "12" = "#4361ee")) 

mouse_correlation_ggpairs_alldays

# Save
mouse_correlation_ggpairs_alldays %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_samples_correlation_ggpairs_alldays.png"),
         height = 10,
         width = 10)
beep()
```

#### PCA

Perform a PCA on the **mouse** EngerixB dataset using log2 fold change
values from each **sample**.

Merge metadata with expression values, reshape the data into a wide
matrix with genes as rows and samples as columns, and replace missing or
non-finite values with zeros.

Run PCA on the transposed matrix to capture sample-level variation, then
extract the first two principal components and merge them back with
sample annotations.

Finally, plot PC1 versus PC2, coloring and filling by timepoint and
labeling by participant, with custom color scales and a themed layout.

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=5}

#Import
mouse_engerixb_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_metadata.rds"))
mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))

#Input
samples_metadata_pca_input = mouse_engerixb_metadata
samples_log2fc_values_pca_input = mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long


#Import metadata
annotation_samples_pca = samples_metadata_pca_input %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "_Day_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(participant_id, timepoint, sample) %>% 
  distinct()


# PCA with raw values
clean_matrix_raw = samples_log2fc_values_pca_input %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "_Day_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(sample, human_symbol, log2fc) %>% 
  filter(!human_symbol == "") %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()

clean_matrix_raw[!is.finite(clean_matrix_raw)] <- 0

pca_raw <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_raw), scale. = TRUE)
pca_raw_df <- as_tibble(pca_raw$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_raw$x)) %>% 
  left_join(annotation_samples_pca, by = "sample")

#Plot
pca_raw <- pca_raw_df %>%
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = timepoint,
      fill = timepoint,
      shape = organism,
      label = participant_id) +
  geom_point(size = 3, 
             alpha = 1, 
             pch = 24, 
             color = "black") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "2" = "#caf0f8",
                                "3" = "#219ebc",
                                "4" = "#219ebc",
                                "6" = "#669bbc",
                                "7" = "#669bbc",
                                "12" = "purple")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "2" = "#caf0f8",
                                "3" = "#219ebc",
                                "4" = "#219ebc",
                                "6" = "#669bbc",
                                "7" = "#669bbc",
                                "12" = "purple")) +
  labs(title = "Mouse, HepB, EngerixB, GSE120661",
       shape = "Organism",
       color = "Timepoint") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank())
pca_raw 

beep()

```







#### BTMs

Annotate mouse genes with Blood Transcription Module (BTM) functional
groups and use them to assess correlations across timepoints. Load
pre-curated BTM annotations and clean the table of functional groups,
then merge it with an external list of immune-related genes. Map mouse
log2 fold change values to BTM processes by joining gene symbols with
their corresponding modules. For each participant and timepoint, compute
the mean log2 fold change per process, reshape the data into a wide
format, and attach module group information.

```{r}
#Import files
btm_annotation_genes =
  read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))
mouse_engerixb_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_metadata.rds"))
mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))

#Annotate genes by BTM
samples_genes_btm = mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  ungroup() %>%

dge_btm_mean_process = samples_genes_btm %>%

               select(process, group, subgroup) %>%

dge_btm_mean_process
```

##### Using ggplot

Compute pairwise correlations of BTM module expression for five mouse
participants at a selected timepoint. Create unique participant pairs,
calculate Pearson correlations and R², and plot scatterplots with
regression lines, colored by module group, faceted by participant pairs,
and labeled with correlation values.

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
#Sample 5 participants
set.seed(31415)

#Create table
ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, timepoint %>% as.numeric)) %>% 
  ungroup()

sample_participants_5 = ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  select(3:7) %>% 
  colnames()

#Inputs
timepoint_selected = 7


plot_data <-
  #Pivot longer, 1st participatn
  ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  filter(timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  select(timepoint, group, process, sample_participants_5) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !c("group", "process", "timepoint"), 
               names_to = "participant_1", 
               values_to = "participant_1_value") %>%
  
  #Add a column to the 2nd participant
  inner_join(
    ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>%
      filter(timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>% 
      select(timepoint, group, process, sample_participants_5) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = !c("group", "process", "timepoint"), 
                   names_to = "participant_2",
                   values_to = "participant_2_value"),
    by = c("process", "group")) %>%
  #Remove pares idênticos (mesma variável)
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
  
  #Remove dupes (ex: A-B e B-A → A-B)
  mutate(pair_min = pmin(participant_1, participant_2),
         pair_max = pmax(participant_1, participant_2)) %>%
  distinct(process, pair_min, pair_max, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  
  # Arrange participants to create a pairwise matrix
  mutate(
    participant_1 = factor(participant_1, levels = sample_participants_5),
    participant_2 = factor(participant_2, levels = rev(sample_participants_5)))


#Calculate correlation
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_1, participant_2) %>%
  summarise(cor_value = cor(participant_1_value, participant_2_value, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(r_squared = cor_value ^ 2,
         cor_label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2), ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2)))


#Plot 
plot_data %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = participant_1_value, y = participant_2_value, color = group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 0.5, se = F, size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_label(data = cor_labels,
            aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label), 
            hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +
  facet_grid(participant_2 ~ participant_1, scales = "free", drop = T) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  labs(x = "Log2FC", 
       y = "Log2FC", 
       color = "",
       title = paste0("Mouse, Hepatitis B, EngerixB Mouse, Day", timepoint_selected))
```

```{r}
probes_annotation <- read.delim(here("tables", "GPL21272-58809.txt"), skip = 19, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "") %>% 
  select(gene_id = ID, entrez_id = ENTREZ_GENE_ID, ensembl_id = ENSEMBL_ID, gene_symbol = GENE_SYMBOL) %>%

### Filter probes with highest median expression
human_engerix_log2summary = human_exprs_engerixb %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(probes_annotation %>% 
              rename(probe = gene_id,
                     entrezgene_id = entrez_id,

            by = "probe") %>% 
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() 

#Filter out genes with multiple hgnc_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = human_engerix_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple hgnc_symbols
  get_dupes(human_symbol)

human_engerix_log2summary = human_engerix_log2summary %>%

  select(human_symbol,
```

### Differential expression


##### Limma
```{r}
#Import
human_engerix_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
human_metadata_filtered = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_metadata.rds"))
eset_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_eset.rds"))

#Create design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + sex + age + race + 0, eset_human) 

#Avoid blank spaces
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

#Get intra-individual correlation
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_human, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_human$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.22

# Fit
engerix_human_limma_fit <- lmFit(eset_human, 
                                 design, 
                                 block = eset_human$participant_id, 
                                 correlation = corfit$consensus)

# Contrasts
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(
  timepoint1 - timepoint0,
  timepoint3 - timepoint0,
  timepoint7 - timepoint0,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(engerix_human_limma_fit, cont.matrix)

# eBayes
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

# Extract
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTable(fit2, coef = i, adjust.method = "fdr", number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
})


# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
all_degs_human = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  #Clean table
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "Time1"	~ "EngerixB_Day1",
                               comparisonA == "Time3"	~ "EngerixB_Day3",
                               comparisonA == "Time7"	~ "EngerixB_Day7",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Human") %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)

all_degs_human %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())
	
#Save
all_degs_human %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
```


##### Simple t-Test
```{r}
#Import
human_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
#Import
human_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")) %>% 
  distinct()

human_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_metadata.rds"))

```


```{r}
#Compute summary statistics
human_log2fc_summary = human_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

human_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = human_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(human_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_")

# Paired t-test
human_log2fc_paired_ttest <- human_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
human_log2fc_unpaired_ttest <- human_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired")

human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = human_log2fc_paired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(human_log2fc_unpaired_ttest) 

human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

### Compare DGE methods
```{r}
#Import ------
#t-Test
human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")
mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse")

#Limma
human_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired",
         timepoint = str_remove(comparison_a, "Time"))

mouse_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired",
         timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Engerix_") %>% str_remove("_PBMC"),
         timepoint = (as.numeric(timepoint)/24) %>% as.character())

#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma =
  bind_rows(
    human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    human_degs,
    mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    mouse_degs
    )

#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_summary = degs_ttest_limma %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, test, paired) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

degs_ttest_limma_summary

```

```{r}
#S aureus: GSE19668 -----
filename = "saureus_infection_GSE19668"
```
