```{r}
eset <- GSE19668[[1]]

#Metadata ------
GSE19668_metadata = eset %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    subject_id = "title",
    # sex = "gender:ch1", 
    treatment = "infection:ch1", 
    # tissue = "tissue:ch1",
    timepoint = "time point:ch1",
    # animal_replicate = "animal replicate:ch1",
    strain = "strain:ch1") %>% 
  mutate(treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "none"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, "0"),
         condition = paste(treatment, strain, timepoint, sep = "_"))

#Save
GSE19668_metadata %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_metadata.rds")))


#Get counts matrix ------
GSE_exprs <- eset %>% exprs()

#Save as RDS
GSE_exprs %>% as.data.frame() %>% saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_exprs.rds")))
```

```{r}
########### Filter and annotate probes -----
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- mouse_exprs %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  pull(probe_id) %>% unique()

# listAttributes(ensembl_mart)
#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("affy_mouse430_2",
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "affy_mouse430_2", #Probes
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart)

#Get lookup table from FIT
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = mouse_ortholog)

#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
mouse_log2summary = mouse_exprs %>% #20,845 probes
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = affy_mouse430_2), 
            by = "probe") %>%  #24.009 rows
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = entrezgene_id) %>% 
  
  #Filter hgnc symbol
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, by = c("mouse_entrez", "mgi_symbol")) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1)  %>% #14.396
  ungroup()

#Filter out genes with multiple mgi_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = mouse_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple mgi_symbols
  get_dupes(hgnc_symbol)

#Filter out probes with multiple mgi and hgnc symbols
probe_dupes = mouse_log2summary %>% get_dupes(probe)

mouse_log2summary = mouse_log2summary %>% 
  select(probe, hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  filter(!hgnc_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$hgnc_symbol %>% unique()),
         !probe %in% c(probe_dupes$probe %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

#Filtered probes
mouse_log2_filtered_probes = mouse_exprs %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(human_symbol = hgnc_symbol,
         probe,
         c(mouse_metadata %>% 
             pull(geo_sample)))
#Check
mouse_log2_filtered_probes %>% dim()
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = mouse_log2_filtered_probes 
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% get_dupes(probe)

#Save
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables","saureus_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
```

### Differential expression 

#### Limma
Paired samples design
```{r}

#Import
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_metadata_filtered.rds"))
eset_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_eset.rds"))

#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
                       eset_mouse) 

colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject (paired-samples)
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_mouse, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_mouse$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.001357108

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_mouse, 
             design, 
             block = eset_mouse$participant_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus) #Use inter-subject correlation as input into the linear model fit

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_2.hours - conditionnone_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_4.hours - conditionnone_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_6.hours - conditionnone_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_12.hours - conditionnone_C57BL.6J_0,
                             levels=design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "conditionnone_C57BL.6J_0", "0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_2.hours"	~ "Saureus_2h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_4.hours"	~ "Saureus_4h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_6.hours"	~ "Saureus_6h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_12.hours"	~ "Saureus_12h",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Mouse",
         timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Saureus_") %>% str_remove("h")) %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)
	
# #Save
all_degs %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

all_degs %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())

```

```{r}
#Import
mouse_exprs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")) %>% 
  ungroup()
mouse_metadata =  readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_metadata_filtered.rds"))
log2fc_sample = readRDS(here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
log2fc_sample_symbol = log2fc_sample %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_exprs %>% 
               select(human_symbol, probe_id = probe) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "probe_id")

```


```{r}
#Compute summary statistics
log2fc_summary = log2fc_sample_symbol %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = mouse_exprs %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(human_symbol, probe),
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, subject_id = participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, subject_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(subject_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "hour_") 

# Paired t-test
log2fc_paired_ttest <- log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_hour2 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_2, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour4 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_4, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour6 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_6, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour12 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_12, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),

    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_hour2 = p.adjust(pval_hour2, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour4 = p.adjust(pval_hour4, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour6 = p.adjust(pval_hour6, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour12 = p.adjust(pval_hour12, method = "fdr"),
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(hour\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "hour"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
log2fc_unpaired_ttest = log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_hour2 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_2, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour4 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_4, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour6 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_6, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour12 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_12, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_hour2 = p.adjust(pval_hour2, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour4 = p.adjust(pval_hour4, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour6 = p.adjust(pval_hour6, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour12 = p.adjust(pval_hour12, method = "fdr"),
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(hour\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "hour"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired") 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = log2fc_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(log2fc_paired_ttest) 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

### Prepare data
```{r}
#S. aureus: GSE33341 -----
filename = "GSE33341"
GSE <- getGEO("GSE33341", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 
eset <- GSE[[2]] #The matrix #1 the mouse annotated

#Metadata ------
GSE_metadata = eset %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    participant_id = "title",
    sex = "host gender:ch1",
    condition = "source_name_ch1",
    pathogen = "pathogen:ch1",
    description = "source_name_ch1", 
    ethnicity = "ethnicity:ch1",
    tissue_infection = "anatomic site of infection:ch1",
    batch_experimental = "experimental batch:ch1",
    age = "host age (yr):ch1") %>% 
  mutate(condition = pathogen,
         organism = "Human",
         timepoint = 1,
         time_unit = "Day",
         tissue = "Blood",
         participant_id = str_extract(participant_id, "\\[.*?\\]") %>% 
           str_remove("\\[") %>% 
           str_remove("\\]"),
         condition = case_when(description == "blood patient with E. coli bacteremia prior antibiotic treatment (Emergency Department)" ~ "E. coli prior antibiotic",
                               description == "blood patient with S. aureus bacteremia prior antibiotic treatment (Emergency Department)" ~ "S aureus prior antibiotic",
                               description == "blood human NOT infected" ~ "No infection",
                               T ~ description),
         pathogen = if_else(pathogen == "-", "Healthy", pathogen))
#Save
GSE_metadata %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_metadata.rds"))

#Filter metadata
GSE_metadata_filtered = GSE_metadata %>%
  filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Healthy")) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, participant_id, condition, timepoint, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(ethnicity = str_to_title(ethnicity)) %>% 
  filter(batch_experimental != "2739",
         ethnicity != "Unknown",
         age != "unknown")

GSE_metadata_filtered %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_metadata.rds"))



#Expression data ------------
GSE_exprs <- exprs(eset) %>% as.data.frame()

#Save
GSE_exprs %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_exprs.rds"))
```

```{r}
#Annotate genes ------
#Human -----
#Annotate data and calculate log2fc
human_exprs_metadata  = human_exprs %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe_id,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "value_raw") %>% 
  inner_join(human_metadata, 
             by = "geo_sample") 

#Get value from healthy and calculate Log2FC
human_exprs_log2fc_sample = human_exprs_metadata %>% 
  filter(pathogen == "Healthy") %>% 
  select(probe_id, value_raw_ref = value_raw) %>% 
  group_by(probe_id) %>% 
  summarise(value_raw_ref = mean(value_raw_ref)) %>% 
  inner_join(human_exprs_metadata %>% 
               filter(pathogen != "Healthy"),
             by = join_by("probe_id")) %>% 
  filter(condition != "No infection") %>% 
  mutate(log2fc = value_raw - value_raw_ref) %>% 
  distinct() 

#Check duplicates
human_exprs_log2fc_sample %>% 
  filter(participant_id == "CSD4620.CEL",
         probe_id == "1007_s_at")

human_exprs_log2fc_sample %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
```

```{r}
########### Filter and annotate probes -----
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
# listDatasets(ensembl_mart)
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("hsapiens_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- human_exprs_log2fc_sample$probe_id %>% unique()

#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("affy_hg_u133a_2",
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "hgnc_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "affy_hg_u133a_2",
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart) %>% 
  #Standardize
  rename(probe = affy_hg_u133a_2,
                     entrezgene_id = entrezgene_id,
                     human_symbol = hgnc_symbol,
                     ensembl_id = ensembl_gene_id)

#Filter genes with highest median expression
human_log2summary = human_exprs %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot, 
            by = "probe") %>% 
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup()  


#Filter out genes with multiple hgnc_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = human_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple hgnc_symbols
  get_dupes(human_symbol)

human_log2summary = human_log2summary %>% 
  filter(!human_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$human_symbol %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

#Filtered probes
human_log2_filtered_probes = human_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
```

### Differential expression

#### Limma

```{r}
#Import
human_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
human_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_metadata.rds"))
eset_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_eset.rds"))

#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ age + sex + ethnicity + batch_experimental + pathogen,
                       data = pData(eset_human))

colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  
rownames(design) <- rownames(pData(eset_human))

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_human, 
             design) 

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(pathogenStaphylococcus.aureus, levels = design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit2)

#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs_human = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  dplyr::select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(condition = case_when(comparison == "pathogenStaphylococcus.aureus"	~ "Saureus_Day1",
                               T~comparison),
         organism = "Human",
         timepoint = "1") %>% 
  dplyr::select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)
	
# #Save
all_degs_human %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

all_degs_human %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n_degs = n())

```


#### T test 
```{r}
#Import
human_exprs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")) 
human_metadata =  readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_metadata.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(condition == "No infection", 0, timepoint))
log2fc_sample = readRDS(here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
log2fc_sample_symbol = log2fc_sample %>% 
  inner_join(human_exprs %>% 
               select(human_symbol, probe_id = probe) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "probe_id")

```


```{r}
#Compute summary statistics
log2fc_summary = log2fc_sample_symbol %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = human_exprs %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(human_symbol, probe),
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(human_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, subject_id = participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, subject_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(subject_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") 


#Unpaired
log2fc_unpaired_ttest = log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1  = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired") 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = log2fc_unpaired_ttest 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

```{r}
#Import ------
#t-Test
human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",

  mutate(organism = "Mouse")

#Limma
human_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Unpaired",
         timepoint = "24") 

mouse_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired") 

#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma =
  bind_rows(
    human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    human_degs,
    mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    mouse_degs
    )

#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_summary = degs_ttest_limma %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, test, paired) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

degs_ttest_limma_summary
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# Plot number of DEGs per test and significance level
degs_ttest_limma_summary_plot_gg <- degs_ttest_limma_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = timepoint,
    y = n_degs,
    fill = test,
    alpha = paired
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_dodge2()) +
  
  # Manual colors per test
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "t-Test" = "gray25",
    "Limma" = "#4DBBD5FF"
  )) +
  
  # Alpha: paired = 1, unpaired = 0.5
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Paired" = 1, "Unpaired" = 0.2)) +
  
  # Continuous x-axis for numeric timepoints
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = sort(unique(degs_ttest_limma_summary$timepoint)),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(
    title = "Total DEGs by test and timepoint, Human",
    subtitle = "Comparison across tests (FDR ≤ 0.05)",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = "Test",
    alpha = "Pairing"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~organism, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray75", linetype = 3),
```

```{r}
#E. coli: GSE33341 -----
filename = "GSE33341"
GSE33341 <- getGEO("GSE33341", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 
eset_mouse <- GSE33341[[1]]
eset_human <- GSE33341[[2]]

#Metadata ------
#Mouse
ecoli_mouse_metadata = eset_mouse %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    #Host
    subject_title = "title",
    subject_num = "replicate number:ch1",
    batch = "experimental batch:ch1",
    host_strain = "host strain:ch1",
    organism = "organism_ch1",
    age = "host age (yr):ch1",
    sex = "host gender:ch1", 
    #Pathogen
    pathogen = "pathogen:ch1",
    status = "infection status:ch1",
    site_infection = "anatomic site of infection:ch1",
    route_infection = "inoculum route:ch1",
    dosage = "pathogen   dosage cfu/g:ch1",
    timepoint = "time after infection (h):ch1",
    bac_strain = "bacterial strain:ch1"
    ) %>% 
  filter(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia  coli", "-")) %>%
  mutate(pathogen = if_else(pathogen == "Escherichia  coli", "escherichia coli", "none"),
         subject_id = paste0("Mouse_", host_strain, "_Animal", subject_num, "_Batch", batch),
         status = str_replace(status, "-", "Healthy"),
         condition = paste("Mouse", host_strain, timepoint, sep = "_"),
         comparison = paste0("Mouse_", host_strain, "_Batch", batch)) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, comparison, condition, subject_id, everything())


#Human
ecoli_human_metadata = eset_human %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  filter(`pathogen:ch1` %in% c("Escherichia coli", "-")) %>%
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    #Host
    subject_title = "title",
    # subject_num = "replicate number:ch1",
    batch = "experimental batch:ch1",
    # host_strain = "host strain:ch1",
    organism = "organism_ch1",
    age = "host age (yr):ch1",
    sex = "host gender:ch1", 
    ethnicity = "ethnicity:ch1",
    #Pathogen
    pathogen = "pathogen:ch1",
    # status = "infection status:ch1",
    site_infection = "anatomic site of infection:ch1"
    # route_infection = "inoculum route:ch1",
    # dosage = "pathogen   dosage cfu/g:ch1",
    # timepoint = "time after infection (h):ch1",
    # bac_strain = "bacterial strain:ch1"
    ) %>% 
  mutate(site_infection = str_to_lower(site_infection),
         organism = "Human",
         pathogen = if_else(pathogen == "-", "Healthy", pathogen),
         status = if_else(pathogen == "Healthy", pathogen, "infected"),
         timepoint = "0",
         subject_id = if_else(pathogen == "Escherichia coli", 
                              paste0("Ecoli_human_", site_infection,"_",geo_sample), 
                              paste0("Healthy_human_", geo_sample)),
         site_infection = if_else(site_infection == "-", "none", site_infection),
         condition = subject_id) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, condition, subject_id, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(pathogen == "Escherichia coli", "24", timepoint))

ecoli_human_metadata
```

```{r}
### Filter probes with highest median expression

  as.data.frame() %>%

  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, by = c("mouse_entrez", "mgi_symbol")) %>%
```

###### Limma
Paired samples design
```{r}

#Import
ecoli_mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol_long.rds"))
ecoli_mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_metadata.rds"))
eset_mouse_ecoli = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_eset.rds"))

#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
                       eset_mouse_ecoli) 

colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject (paired-samples)
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_mouse_ecoli, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_mouse_ecoli$subject_id)
corfit$consensus #-0.06

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_mouse_ecoli, 
             design, 
             block = eset_mouse_ecoli$subject_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus) #Use inter-subject correlation as input into the linear model fit

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_2	 - conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_6	 - conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_12	 - conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_24	 - conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_0,
                             levels=design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs_mouse_ecoli= all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_2"	~ "Ecoli_2h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_6"	~ "Ecoli_6h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_12"	~ "Ecoli_12h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_24"	~ "Ecoli_24h",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Mouse",
         timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Ecoli_") %>% str_remove("h")) %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)
	
# #Save
all_degs_mouse_ecoli %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

all_degs_mouse_ecoli %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())

```



###### T test
```{r}
#Import
mouse_exprs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol_long.rds"))

```


```{r}
#Compute summary statistics
log2fc_summary = log2fc_sample_symbol %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = mouse_exprs %>%
  select(-probe) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, subject_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, subject_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(subject_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "hour_") 

# Paired t-test
log2fc_paired_ttest <- log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_hour2 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_2, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour6 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_6, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour12 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_12, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour24 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_24, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_hour2 = p.adjust(pval_hour2, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour6 = p.adjust(pval_hour6, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour12 = p.adjust(pval_hour12, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour24 = p.adjust(pval_hour24, method = "fdr"),
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(hour\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "hour"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
log2fc_unpaired_ttest = log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_hour2 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_2, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour6 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_6, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour12 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_12, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour24 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_24, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_hour2 = p.adjust(pval_hour2, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour6 = p.adjust(pval_hour6, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour12 = p.adjust(pval_hour12, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour24 = p.adjust(pval_hour24, method = "fdr"),
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(hour\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "hour"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired") 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = log2fc_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(log2fc_paired_ttest) 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))
```

```{r}
#Import
human_ecoli_log2_filtered_symbol = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
ecoli_human_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_metadata.rds"))
eset_human_ecoli = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_eset.rds"))


#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ age + sex + ethnicity + status,
                       data = pData(eset_human_ecoli))

colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces
rownames(design) <- rownames(pData(eset_human_ecoli))

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_human_ecoli, 
             design) 

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(statusinfected, levels = design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit2)

#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs_human_ecoli= all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  dplyr::select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "statusinfected"	~ "Ecoli_24h",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Human",
        timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Ecoli_") %>% str_remove("h")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)
	
# #Save
all_degs_human_ecoli %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

all_degs_human_ecoli %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n_degs = n())

```




###### T test
```{r}
#Import
human_exprs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
human_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_metadata.rds"))
log2fc_sample = readRDS(here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
log2fc_sample_symbol = log2fc_sample %>% 
  inner_join(human_exprs %>% 
               select(human_symbol, probe_id = probe),
             by = "probe_id")


#Compute summary statistics
log2fc_summary = log2fc_sample_symbol %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = log2fc_sample_symbol %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(human_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, subject_id, timepoint, day0_value_raw, value_raw) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(subject_id, human_symbol, timepoint, hour_0 = day0_value_raw, value = value_raw) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "hour_")

#Unpaired
log2fc_unpaired_ttest = log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(pval_hour24 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_24, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(padj_hour24 = p.adjust(pval_hour24, method = "fdr")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(hour\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "hour"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired") 


log2fc_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_log2fc_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

#### Compare DGE methods
```{r}
#Import ------
#t-Test
human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_log2fc_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")
mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse")

#Limma
human_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Unpaired") 

mouse_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired") 

#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma =
  bind_rows(
    human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    human_degs,
    mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    mouse_degs
    )

#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_summary = degs_ttest_limma %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, test, paired) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

degs_ttest_limma_summary

```


```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# Plot number of DEGs per test and significance level
degs_ttest_limma_summary_plot_gg <- degs_ttest_limma_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = timepoint,
    y = n_degs,
    fill = test,
    alpha = paired
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_dodge2()) +
  
  # Manual colors per test
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "t-Test" = "gray25",
    "Limma" = "#4DBBD5FF"
  )) +
  
  # Alpha: paired = 1, unpaired = 0.5
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Paired" = 1, "Unpaired" = 0.2)) +
  
  # Continuous x-axis for numeric timepoints
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = sort(unique(degs_ttest_limma_summary$timepoint)),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(
    title = "Total DEGs by test and timepoint",
    subtitle = "Comparison across tests (FDR ≤ 0.05)",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = "Test",
    alpha = "Pairing"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~organism, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray75", linetype = 3),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray75")
  )

# Render plot
degs_ttest_limma_summary_plot_gg

degs_ttest_limma_summary_plot_gg %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_ttest_limma_summary.png"),
         width = 5,
         height = 5)
```
